documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our wholesale distribution team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The account is in the 'nurture' stage with a score of 50 and an intent of 50. The customer has provided consent and is currently exploring options without a specific project owner identified. The account is not blocked, and the owner is cedar-east.

claims.quote: Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.
A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for your inquiry. We understand that your wholesale distribution team is currently exploring options and has not yet identified a specific project owner. To ensure we align with your needs, we recommend scheduling a discovery meeting to clarify your requirements and establish integration goals.

Our team is ready to assist and can provide further details on how Cedar Systems can support your workflow coordination and account reporting needs.

Please let us know a convenient time to schedule this meeting.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What is the expected timeline for identifying a project owner?
Are there any specific departments or stakeholders who should be involved in the discovery meeting?
uncertainties: The lack of a specific project owner may delay the discovery meeting.
The customer's exact requirements are not yet defined.
